examples.title: Example 1: Setting Sheets with Different Heights
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to set different heights for sheets using the height attribute.

examples.title: Example 2: Setting Three Different Height Detents
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to use the detents attribute of bindSheet to set three different height detents for a sheet.

examples.title: Example 3: Setting the Border Width and Color
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to use the borderWidth and borderColor attributes with LocalizedEdgeWidths and LocalizedEdgeColors types in bindSheet.

examples.title: Example 4: Using Dismiss Callbacks
examples.description: This example shows how to register onWillDismiss and onWillSpringBackWhenDismiss with bindSheet.

examples.title: Example 5: Setting the Content Update Mode
examples.description:
This example shows how to use ScrollSizeMode.CONTINUOUS, which continuously updates the content and is suitable for detents with multiple height settings.
Whenever possible, minimize UI loading time within the builder, as real-time content refreshing during scrolling has higher performance requirements.

examples.title: Example 6: Configuring the Sheet to Resize to Avoid the Keyboard
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to adjust the scrollable content within a sheet when the keyboard height changes by setting SheetKeyboardAvoidMode to RESIZE_ONLY.

examples.title: Example 7: Setting the Corner Radius in a Mirrored Layout
examples.description:
This example demonstrates how to set different corner radii for a sheet in a mirrored layout. Typically, to avoid a poor visual experience, do not set different values.
Since API version 15, the radius attribute supports the LocalizedBorderRadiuses type.

examples.title: Example 8: Implementing a Side Sheet
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to implement a side sheet. This feature is supported since API version 20.

examples.title: Example 9: Implementing a Full-Screen Content Cover Sheet
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to implement a full-screen sheet. This feature is supported since API version 20.
